story.titleZh: 凯迪拉克查明博塔斯墨西哥撞车原因并回退悬挂规格
story.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队在查明博塔斯墨西哥站撞车原因后，决定回退一款悬挂部件的规格。博塔斯表示腿部肌肉挫伤已“完全恢复正常”，本周末可以正常参赛。
story.originalTitle: Bottas crash diagnosis and his bold stance on Cadillac F1 future
story.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team is rolling back the specification of a suspension component after diagnosing the cause of Valtteri Bottas's crash in Mexico. Bottas says his leg muscle bruising already feels "completely normal" and he has no issue getting back in the car this weekend.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队在查明上周末瓦尔特利·博塔斯在墨西哥戏剧性撞车的原因后，正在回退一款悬挂部件的规格。
博塔斯在墨西哥站第一个弯道左前悬挂失效，赛车倒退着撞上缓冲区深处的护墙，因此退赛。
幸运的是，博塔斯避免了严重到造成重大持久损伤的撞击。他周四在巴西透露，事发后他立即感到疼痛——当时他在无线电里一反常态地大声喊叫，并留在车内与FIA医疗团队交流——是因为赛车撞上护墙时他的右腿撞到了方向盘。
这让博塔斯留下了一些肌肉挫伤，他说现在感觉“已经完全恢复正常”，而且本周末重新坐进赛车没有问题，因为凯迪拉克已经查明了原因。
这与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在加拿大因制动导管热风泄漏导致前悬挂故障的情况类似，博塔斯的问题源于制动器产生的热量“传到了叉臂”。
无论如何，与佩雷斯相比，他的驾驶风格在制动器上倾向于产生更高的温度，但主要问题似乎是墨西哥赛道的挑战超出了凯迪拉克设定的容差范围，并且“在红色区域运行时间过长”。
在英特拉格斯赛道，由于这条赛道对制动和冷却的需求较低，这种情况不应重演，但凯迪拉克还是采取了必要的纠正措施作为预防，之后博塔斯表示需要“为未来进行良好的重新设计”。
“我们在温度方面确实有过某些限制，但我们不得不重新审视这些限制，”博塔斯说。
“我们不得不把一些部件改回旧规格。而且我们还不得不调低这些部件可以运行的温度上限。”
当被 The Race 问及那次规格变更时，博塔斯澄清道：“只是叉臂安装座的问题，是的。而且我们已经降低了限制，这在这里应该不成问题。”
“我们原以为那是安全的，但我们从未通过让它在那个温度下运行那么长时间来测试过。”
他补充道：“根据这里的天气预报，我认为我们应该没问题。”
“但他们在工厂还在用悬挂右侧部件做更多测试，那个部件现在已经回到银石了。”
“所以他们在做一些应力测试，并试图获得更精确的温度限制。”
博塔斯今年有一些令人沮丧的比赛表现，直接原因是不得不进行大量温度管理。
这对凯迪拉克来说一直是个以不同方式反复出现的问题，博塔斯似乎受影响更大，这无助于他对阵佩雷兹，后者被广泛认为是表现明显更好的凯迪拉克车手。
博塔斯几周前在美国大奖赛上表示，考虑到凯迪拉克作为新加入者的身份以及本赛季糟糕的可靠性记录，他认为评判这两位车手是“不可能的”——考虑到目前有关于他在车队未来的猜测，这一点尤为重要。
凯迪拉克正在努力确保科尔顿·赫塔获得F1超级驾照资格，尽管博塔斯签有多年合同，其他车手也一直在游说争取车队的比赛席位。
因此，博塔斯反复面临关于自己未来的问题，这种情况在英特拉格斯再次出现——他在那里表示“至少每个人都能看到我们面对的情况——许多问题和许多退赛”。
“而且不知为何，我的车在墨西哥温度更高，”博塔斯说。
“所以这意味着我必须做更多的管理，更多的抬油门滑行。而且即使我做了，我们仍然出现了故障。
“所以就今年表现的评价而言，并不是那么直接明了。”
博塔斯表示“懂的人自然懂”，并重申他从凯迪拉克及其多数股东TWG那里得到的信息是，他做得很好。
他预计自己的未来将在包括共同所有者通用汽车在内的董事会会议上得到正式确认，并且对他未来以及其他人候选资格的“大量噪音”感到“相当惊讶”。
“我所听到的一切都是，车队对我正在做的事情感到满意，”他说。
“但与此同时，我们知道这个世界是如何运作的。尤其是现在，每个人都想进入一级方程式。
“如果有人在某处看到了机会，他们就会想方设法去争取，无论以何种方式。
“但按照我们车队的架构方式，以及为未来做决策的方式，一切都需要得到董事会的批准。
“我相信那次会面还没有发生。但我一直确信没有任何变化。所以这就是我们目前的状况。”
尽管博塔斯觉得自己本赛季承担了车队大部分的问题，佩雷斯也经常直言凯迪拉克需要改进的地方还有很多。
不过，佩雷斯最近已将他的凯迪拉克合同延长至2029年，他在队内的位置似乎一直稳固得多。他出色的表现有时也让他有底气非常直率地谈论车队的发展曲线。
与此同时，博塔斯正在等待确认最初让他保留比赛席位的计划会得到履行，更不用说同意一份新合同了。
他说，凯迪拉克所处的局面，包括种种困难以及“他们并没有真正给我一辆能让我大有作为的赛车”这一事实，“一直是我第一年所预料的”——并称墨西哥站是一个“很好的例子”，说明凯迪拉克“目前要解决的问题比车手问题更大”。
博塔斯补充说，他对今年的预期“绝对不是一种为保住席位而战的心态”，当《The Race》提出，把他请来是为了经验和长期进步、随后却判定其表现不符合凯迪拉克的期望会略显奇怪时，他回答说：“我同意。那会非常奇怪。
“所以这就是为什么我不认为我的处境会有任何改变。
“这差不多一直就是约定。整个赛季我一直在真正遵循指令。有时候非常清楚，我只是努力把赛车带到终点线。
“但当然，总有一些人从外部观察，他们或许并不了解全局。然后你就会受到批评，这在赛车运动中很正常。”
“最重要的是我们知道自己的位置。我知道我的工作是什么。如果他们对我有进一步的要求，我相信他们会告诉我。”
detailEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team is rolling back the specification of a suspension component after diagnosing the cause of Valtteri Bottas’s dramatic crash in Mexico last weekend.
Bottas shunted out of the Mexico race when his front left suspension failed at the first corner, sending the car backwards into the barrier deep into the run-off.

Fortunately, Bottas avoided a heavy enough hit to do significant lasting damage, as he revealed on Thursday in Brazil that his pain immediately afterwards - when he was uncharacteristically loud on the radio, and stayed in the car speaking to the FIA medical team - was because he banged his right leg against the steering wheel when the car made contact with the wall.

That left Bottas with some muscle bruising that he says feels “completely normal already”, and he has no issue getting back into the car again this weekend because Cadillac has already identified the cause.

Similar to when Sergio Perez suffered a front suspension failure in Canada due to a leak of hot air from brake ducts, Bottas’s problem arose from running heat from the brakes “going to the wishbones”.

He tends to run a bit hotter on the brakes with his driving style compared to Perez anyway, but the primary issue seems to be the Mexico challenge exceeding what Cadillac had set its tolerances to and “running too long a time in the red zone”.

This should not be repeated at Interlagos with less of a braking and cooling demand at this track, but Cadillac has taken the necessary corrective action as a precaution anyway before what Bottas said needs to be “good redesigning for the future”.
“We did have certain limits when it comes to temperatures, but we’ve had to review those,” Bottas said.
“We’ve had to revert some parts to older spec. And also we’ve had to revert the limits on temperatures that we can run on those.”
Asked by The Race about that spec change, Bottas clarified: “It’s just the wishbone mountings, yeah. And we’ve lowered the limits, which shouldn’t be an issue here.
“We thought it was safe, but we never tested by running it so long at that temperature.”
He added: “Based on the forecast here, I think we should be OK.
“But they’re still doing more testing at the factory with the right side of the suspension, that is now back in Silverstone.
“So they’re doing some stress testing and trying to get more accurate temperature limits on those.”
Bottas has had some demoralising race performances this year caused directly by having to engage in a lot of temperature management.

It has been a recurring issue for Cadillac in different ways, with Bottas seemingly more affected, which has not aided his cause against Perez, who is widely regarded as being the better performing Cadillac driver by some margin.

Bottas said at the United States Grand Prix a couple of weeks ago that he felt it was “impossible” to judge the two drivers given Cadillac’s newcomer status and poor reliability record this season – particularly significant right now given there is speculation over his future at the team.
Cadillac is pushing to make sure Colton Herta is eligible for an F1 superlicence and other drivers have been lobbying for a race seat with the team, despite Bottas being on a multi-year contract.
Bottas has therefore faced repeat questions about his future and this reoccurred at Interlagos - where he said “at least everyone can see what we’re dealing with – many issues and many DNFs”.
“And also for some reason my car was running hotter in Mexico,” Bottas said.
“So it meant I had to do more management, more lift and coast. And even though I did, still we had a failure.
“So it’s not so straightforward in terms of judging the performance this year.”
Bottas said “the people who know, they know” and reiterated that the message he has had from Cadillac and its majority owner TWG is that he is doing a good job.
He expects his future to be rubber-stamped by a board meeting involving co-owner General Motors and has been “quite surprised by the amount of noise” around his future and the candidacy of others.
“All I’ve heard, the team has been happy with what I’m doing,” he said.
“But at the same time, we know how this world works. And especially now, everyone wants to be in Formula 1.
“If somebody sees an opportunity somewhere, they’re going to try and go for it, one way or the other.
“But the way our team is structured, and the way decisions are made for the future, everything needs to be approved by the board.
“I believe that meeting is still yet to happen. But I’ve been convinced that nothing has changed. So that’s where we are.”
Though Bottas feels he has had the lion’s share of the team’s problems this season, Perez has often been outspoken about just how much Cadillac needs to improve.

Perez, though, extended his Cadillac deal through to 2029 recently and has always seemed to have much more security in his position. The quality of his performances has also emboldened him to speak very bluntly about the team’s progress curve at times, too.
Bottas, meanwhile, is waiting for confirmation that the original plan to keep him in a race seat is honoured, much less agree to a new deal.

He said the situation Cadillac’s in, including the difficulties and the fact “they haven’t really delivered me the car that I can do much” with, is “always what I expected for the first year” – and called Mexico a “good example” that Cadillac has “bigger problems to solve than the drivers at the moment”.

Bottas added that his expectation for this year was “definitely not a mindset to fight for my seat” and when suggested by The Race that it would be slightly odd to bring him in for experience and long-term progress, then make a judgement that the performance is not what Cadillac was looking for, he replied: “I agree. It would be very odd.
“So that’s why I don’t think anything is going to change in my situation.
“That was kind of always the deal. All season I’ve been really following instructions. Sometimes it has been very clear that I just try and get the car to the finish line.
“But of course there’s always people who look from the outside, they maybe don’t understand the big picture. Then you get the criticism, which is normal in this sport.
“The main thing is we know where we are. I know what my job is. If they want something further from me, then I’m sure they will tell me.”

与佩雷兹在加拿大因刹车导管热气泄漏导致前悬挂失效类似，博塔斯的问题源于刹车热量传到叉臂（wishbones）。

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)

19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
